title: R. Buckminster Fuller and E. J. Applewhite — FBI Records (re-file)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

I submitted this request through MuckRock on July 29, 2026 and received no acknowledgment, so I am filing it again. I request FBI records, including main files and cross-references, about:

1. Richard Buckminster Fuller (born July 12, 1895; died July 1, 1983), architect, inventor, and author.
2. Edgar Jarratt Applewhite Jr. (born April 24, 1919; died February 10, 2005), former CIA officer and co-author with Fuller of Synergetics (1975) and Synergetics 2 (1979).

Both were born more than 100 years ago. Published obituaries confirm their deaths: Fuller, New York Times, July 3, 1983 (https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Obituaries/Fuller_NY_Times); Applewhite (https://encyclopedia.com/arts/educational-magazines/applewhite-edgar-jarratt-jr-1919-2005).

I request a waiver of fees. Disclosure will contribute to public understanding of government activities; I will publish released records free of charge, and this request is not for commercial use.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Daniel Friedman

title: William Blake — NEA Grant Records, 2019–present (narrowed re-file of F26-083)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

This replaces request F26-083, closed September 14. I request the following records of the National Endowment for the Arts, January 1, 2019 to the date of search, within NEA's seven-year retention period:

1. A list of NEA grants whose project description mentions "William Blake."
2. For those grants, the application's project description and the final descriptive report.

Please search "Blake" only together with "William" or with a Blake title: Songs of Innocence, Songs of Experience, The Marriage of Heaven and Hell, Jerusalem, or The Tyger. I am not requesting staff correspondence or internal memoranda.

title: Active Inference — AFOSR Award Records (narrowed re-file of 2026-07793-F)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

This narrows my request 2026-07793-F, which AFOSR closed on October 26 after its September 1 request for clarification went unanswered. I request the following records of the Air Force Office of Scientific Research, January 1, 2010 to the date of search. I am not requesting internal or external correspondence at this stage.

1. A list or export from AFOSR's grants system of awards whose title, abstract, or statement of work contains "active inference," "free energy principle," or "variational free energy," showing award number, recipient, program, dates, and amount.
2. For those awards, and for FA9550-24-1-0313 (University of Washington, "Active Predictive Coding Models of Cortical and Subcortical Function," 2024–2027) and FA8650-11-1-7156 (UCLA, 2011–2017, statement of work beginning "Mathematical Modeling, Analysis and Active Inference of…"), the statement of work, proposal abstract, and final or most recent annual technical report.
3. AFOSR research announcements and program descriptions that use those terms.

I request a waiver of fees. Disclosure will contribute to public understanding of how the government funds research on these topics; I will publish released records free of charge, and this request is not for commercial use.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.
